name: armadorpc
description: ArmadorPC: configurador de PC y comparador de precios de Ecuador (NestJS + SQLite + Vite)

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,yellow "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,yellow "npm run start:demo --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
